jurisdiction.name: Micronesia (Federated States of)
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: The Federated States of Micronesia has no national AI law, strategy or official AI guidance. Its digital governance work centres on connectivity and three pending bills on cybersecurity, cybercrime and personal data protection, none of which contains AI provisions.
lead_institutions: Department of Transportation, Communications and Infrastructure
Congress of the Federated States of Micronesia
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 13 October 2026 from Congress's, the government portal's and the communications department's websites. The telecommunications regulator's website could not be accessed and the legal database could only be partly read. The pending data protection bill and the college's AI-use policy are tracked as leads.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: The Congress site and its pending bills, the national Code index, the President's office, the transport and communications department, other departments and regulators were searched at national level. No qualifying AI-governance document was found in any category. The telecommunications regulator's site and the Code's text search were unavailable, and the Cybersecurity Roadmap 2021 link is broken, so these remain to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note: Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-13, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. fsmtra.fm refused by network (web search only); fsmlaw.org reset (Code title index via WebFetch only). National ICT and Telecommunications Policy 2012 read: no AI. C.B. 24-14, 24-15, 24-17 and SCR 24-28/29/30 read: no AI, deepfake or automated-decision provisions. College of Micronesia-FSM Board Policy 8940 (AI, 27 Aug 2025) internal institutional policy (lead). Cybersecurity Roadmap 2021 link 404. Convention 108: not a party. Units covered: Law: Searched, nothing found. Congress of the FSM site (cfsm.gov.fm) searched for 'artificial intelligence'/'artificial' (only two news posts on parliamentary conferences); pending C.B. 24-14, 24-15 and 24-17 and committee reports SCR 24-28/29/30 read in full: no AI, deepfake or automated-decision provisions. FSM Code title index on fsmlaw.org (via WebFetch) has no data-protection, cyber or AI title; Title 21 Telecommunications chapters listed on tci.gov.fm are spectrum/telecom rules. No enacted AI law or AI provision found.; Government: Searched, nothing found. President's Office/PIO site gov.fm searched (no AI policy, strategy or guideline); Department of Transportation, Communications and Infrastructure communications page reviewed: FSM National ICT and Telecommunications Policy 2012 read in full (no AI content), Cybersecurity Roadmap 2021 link broken (lead), Digital FSM project documents are World Bank safeguard plans. No national AI strategy, digital strategy with an AI pillar, or public-sector AI guidance found.; Ministries: Searched, nothing found for Education (national department; only the College of Micronesia-FSM's own AI policy, held as a lead), Health and Social Affairs, Justice (cybersecurity symposium releases only, no AI document), Finance, Foreign Affairs. No ministry AI documents found.; Regulators: Searched, nothing found. No data protection authority exists (PDP bill pending); FSM Telecommunications Regulation Authority site not reachable (connection refused by network) and search found no AI material; FSM Banking Board: no AI material found; no cyber agency yet (CERT proposed in C.B. 24-14).. Not reached: FSM Telecommunications Regulation Authority website (fsmtra.fm) could not be reached; covered by web search only; fsmlaw.org Code text search (site reset connection; title index read via WebFetch only). leads.title: C.B. No. 24-17: A Bill for an Act to enact the FSM Personal Data Protection Act of 2025 as chapter 1 entitled "Data Protection" under title 16 of the Code of the Federated States of Micronesia (Annotated)
leads.english_title: Congressional Bill 24-17: FSM Personal Data Protection Act of 2025
leads.issuing_authority: Congress of the Federated States of Micronesia
leads.note: Pending bill (24th Congress, First Regular Session 2025), full text at https://www.cfsm.gov.fm/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CB-24-17.pdf (read via curl). Would create a personal data protection regime for core National Government departments and agencies with judicial remedies; it covers processing 'whether or not by automated means' but has no AI or automated-decision-making provisions. Standing Committee Report No. 24-30 (Judiciary and Governmental Operations, Fourth Regular Session 2026, https://www.cfsm.gov.fm/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/SCR-No.-24-30.pdf) records hearings in Yap, Chuuk and Kosrae (Nov-Dec 2025) and defers to the Committee on Resources and Development. Record as data-privacy binding_law if enacted.

leads.title: C.B. No. 24-14 (cybersecurity framework, CERT) and C.B. No. 24-15 (national cybercrime offences)
leads.issuing_authority: Congress of the Federated States of Micronesia
leads.note: Pending bills, texts at https://www.cfsm.gov.fm/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CB-24-14.pdf and https://www.cfsm.gov.fm/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/CB-24-15.pdf (read via curl): no AI, deepfake or algorithmic provisions (only 'computer data representing algorithms' in a definition). Standing Committee Report No. 24-29 (May 2026) does not recommend passage of C.B. 24-15 in its current form; SCR 24-28 defers C.B. 24-14 to another committee. Not AI instruments; noted only so a future cyber-security pass can check for AI-security content.

leads.title: College of Micronesia-FSM Board Policy No. 8940: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Policy, and Administrative Procedure 8940
leads.english_title: College of Micronesia-FSM Board Policy 8940 on Artificial Intelligence and Administrative Procedure 8940
leads.issuing_authority: College of Micronesia-FSM Board of Regents
leads.note: Official document on comfsm.fm (https://www.comfsm.fm/Policy/Board-Policy/Chapter-8/COMFSM_BP8940_AI.pdf, read via curl; AP at https://www.comfsm.fm/Policy/Administrative-Procedure/Chapter-8/COMFSM_AP8940.pdf), stated 'Date Adopted: 27 August 2025'. Sets ethical-use principles, disclosure and prohibited uses of AI for students, faculty and staff of the national public college. Held as a lead: an individual institution's internal AI-use policy, not a national government instrument (scope test, PROTOCOL §1).
